title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18

ai_review.summary: Strong midnight marathon with standout Dark Star and St. Stephen; audience recording is uneven but listenable
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the epic September 18‑1970 performance – a near‑six‑hour midnight set that flows beautifully with teases, dark jams and soaring renditions of Dark Star and St. Stephen. The recording is an audience capture that some find muddy or in need of cleaning, though others praise its upload quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the musical performance (70% weight) and mixed but generally acceptable audio quality (30% weight) lead to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as not great, with some sections muddy and callers asking for a cleaned‑up version; however several reviewers note the upload is solid and the show remains enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon midnight set that weaves teases into expansive jams, moving fluidly from dark explorations to uplifting numbers and ending with an unforgettable Dark Star.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned playing with the New Riders during intermission; no specific comment on his guitar work in this show.
